about: Acceptance criterion 5: the agent answers five scripted questions citing the expected sources. Each question passes when every ID in expected_sources is among the sources the answer cites (url_citation annotations, mapped to the index field sourceId). acceptable_sources may also be cited without failing the question. Facts come from the seed manifest (data_version 3.0); manifest_ref names the entry each expectation traces to.

questions.question: Backup jobs at a customer fail with error RBA-2201 and no new restore points are created. What causes this, and how do we resolve it? Cite your sources.
questions.manifest_ref: scenarios.new_incident_adatum_expected.true_matches (article KB0023, its history and open ticket TCK-10521)

questions.kind: Ambiguous: conflicting articles decided by the customer's versions
questions.question: Woodgrove Bank users are disconnected from Remote Access about every hour. Which knowledge article applies to Woodgrove Bank, and which of the customer's versions decide it? Cite your sources.
questions.manifest_ref: scenarios.conflicting_pairs.pairs[0]: CUST-007 has Remote Access 4.2.0 and Secure Gateway 10.1.4, so KB0058 applies, not KB0031

questions.kind: Ambiguous: conflicting articles decided by the contract type
questions.question: Margie's Travel asks us to change a firewall rule. Which knowledge article applies to them, and why? Cite your sources.
questions.manifest_ref: scenarios.conflicting_pairs.pairs[2]: CUST-009 has a Break-Fix contract, so KB0045 applies, not KB0044

questions.question: For a P2 incident at Humongous Insurance, whom does Relecloud phone first, and during which hours is the claims document management application business-critical? Cite your sources.
questions.manifest_ref: scenarios.customer_documents.escalation_procedures.CUST-013 = CDOC-026 (Kofi Kim first; claims intake hours 08:00 to 18:00)

questions.kind: Grounding for the second new incident: article and runbook
questions.question: Dispatchers at Consolidated Messenger's north depot see a warning that the routing application's security certificate has expired, while the south depot works. Which knowledge article and runbook apply, and which server is affected? Cite your sources.
questions.manifest_ref: scenarios.new_incident_consolidated_expected (article KB0133, runbook RB-005, CDOC-032 names server CMRT-N01); the incident TCK-10562 itself is never indexed
